verdict.rationale: Square ships official SDKs (e.g. square-nodejs-sdk with documented client init, method calls, version overrides) alongside comprehensive API docs, sandbox testing, OAuth scopes, GraphQL, and an official MCP server (both local npx and hosted remote with OAuth) explicitly designed for AI-agent consumption, including llms.txt agent guidance. This directly satisfies building against official SDKs in an AI-native/agentic context. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of SDK quality/reliability beyond vendor docs and GitHub snippets, and broader multi-language SDK evidence beyond Node.js.
